title: Multiple Choice – Word Families
description: Choose the correct word to complete each sentence.

questions.text: Everyone in the audience expressed deep __________ for the surgeon's tireless dedication.
With regular practice and perseverance, your academic goals are completely __________.
Despite multiple setbacks, the athlete remained __________ to win the international championship.
From an early age, Daniel showed immense __________ to become a leading aerospace engineer.
The young journalist conducted interviews __________ without receiving guidance from senior staff.
Sister Teresa showed profound __________ to helping impoverished communities throughout her life.
The studio produced an exciting __________ feature film that attracted millions of young viewers.
The ancient tree stood completely __________ after several months of severe summer drought.
The visiting soccer players looked deeply __________ as they walked off the pitch after the match.
The founder had a clear __________ for transforming clean energy technology across the continent.
